full_judgment: 11. Keeping in view the above argument let me address myself to resolve the controversy whether the petitioner could make out a case for reversal of the findings and decision of the Courts below on the ground that they committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice in disbelieving the claim of the defendant-petitioner regarding denial of execution of any agreement whatsoever for the sale of the suit property and receipt of the consideration money, if any, from the plaintiff and thereby adopted two different views in assess merit of the instant case.
